claims.statement: For the family T_m consisting of path a-b-r with m three-leaf arms at r, the favorable-leaf aggregate is strictly negative at every eligible rank for 1<=m<=999.
claims.scope: Exact finite family conclusion only: ordinary trees T_m, 1<=m<=999, x(T_m)+2<=p, and 3p<2alpha(T_m)+1. The unbounded m claim and all-tree primary are not carried.
claims.reason: retained_narrowed: independent exact replay reproduces all finite central checks and all eligible selector/full-sum rows through m=999, and the graph split identities give the stated complete tagged-sum formula. The case does not establish, to this critic's independent audit, every all-m analytic tail estimate or the exact descent-bound bridge required beyond that finite range; see REPORT.md. This is a bounded family result, not a refutation or proof of the general primary.

limitations: The exact arithmetic replay is Python-based and not kernel checked.
The m>=1000 analytic tail inequalities and uniform cutoff derivation were not independently certified.
The forest descent bound application used to locate the first descent in the central rank window was not independently proved or matched to a precise cited theorem in the case files.
No conclusion is given for arbitrary ordinary trees or the general lower-region favorable-leaf aggregate.
